Massive thanks to everyone who has helped give feedback on the demo and wishlisted the game to push it in the Steam algorithm! <3[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Steam Demo has received an overhaul including:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized Entrance Room to better communicate mechanics to new players.[/p][/*][*][p]Countless visual upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]70+ New Room Templates.[/p][/*][*][p]8 New Artifacts.[/p][/*][*][p]MANY Bug fixes![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]You can check out all of the cool available perks and upcoming features to the full game on the [b]Kickstarter page[/b]: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sillykitty/bobos-big-tower"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sillykitty/bobos-big-tower[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Don't forget to purchase the game's Early Bird option for a substantial discount!![/i][/b][/p]
